'''House a'Cowel''' is a house from [[Murandy]]. 

Its only known member is [[Nisain a'Cowel]], an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Gray Ajah]]. She chose to join the [[Salidar]] [[Rebel Aes Sedai|Aes Sedai]] during the [[White Tower Schism]].{{ref/book|10|30}}
